sprites.layout: each frame: packed RGB565 plane, then A8 plane

runtime.facing: frames face right; for direction -1 read source columns in reverse

pitchShear.rule: column c draws at y + round((c - (width-1)/2) * pitch * perPixel), pitch in [-0.6, 0.6], computed in unmirrored sprite space

runtime.shadeRule: per channel: min(255, round(c8 * mul + add)), then quantise to RGB565; fish use layer 0 -> dayFar/nightFar, layer 1 -> day/night
runtime.frameSelection: see AquaGame.pose(): swim frame from tail phase, turn frame 0 / 1 / 1 / 0 across the turn, walk frame from distance walked
